outcome: mRNA and protein expression levels of PTGE synthase (PTGES)
mRNA and protein expression levels of PTGE receptors 2/4 (PTGER2/4)
mRNA and protein expression levels of 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase (HPGD)
mRNA and protein expression levels of PG-transporter (PGT) in interplacental (IP) and uteroplacental (UP) tissues
cohort: The study included bitches presented with dystocia who underwent emergency caesarean section, categorized into groups of primary uterine inertia (PUI, n=12) and obstructive dystocia (OD, n=8).
finding: The study did not find significant differences in PTGES, PTGER2, PTGER4, HPGD, and PGT mRNA expressions between PUI and OD overall, suggesting these expressions are not likely causative for PUI, although higher PTGES expression was observed in PUI with normal litter size (PUI-N) compared to OD and other PUI litter sizes.
cross-section timing: Tissues were collected during emergency caesarean sections.
